description: See how Anime Cabinet transforms a couple photo into a hand-drawn anime portrait, with 24 style options, a preview within 72 hours, and unlimited free revisions.
intro: A meaningful couple photo can become more than a memory on your phone. With Anime Cabinet, a human artist redraws your image as an original couple anime portrait, preserving recognizable expressions, poses, clothing details, and the feeling between you. This is not an AI filter or an instant photo effect. It is a custom anime portrait from photo, created by an artist and refined with your feedback. From a wedding photograph to an anniversary snapshot, the process turns a shared moment into artwork you can display digitally or order as a custom anime portrait canvas. You receive a preview within 72 hours as standard, plus unlimited free revisions so the finished illustration feels personal to both of you.

sections.heading: Before and after: what changes in a couple photo to anime portrait?

blocks.text: The before image is your original photograph: two people, a real setting, natural lighting, and all the small details that make the moment yours. The after image keeps the identity and emotion of that scene while translating it into an anime or cartoon visual language. A human artist redraws facial features, hair, clothing, hands, pose, and composition rather than applying a preset effect.

The result is an original character interpretation of your relationship. You can request a romantic close-up, a full-body composition, a playful adventure scene, or a more dramatic poster-style design. Backgrounds can remain recognizable, be simplified, or be replaced with a setting that suits your chosen theme. The goal is not to impersonate copyrighted characters. Instead, you and your partner become original characters inspired by the visual language of the selected style.

First, upload your couple photo and describe what you would like changed or preserved. Tell the artist which style you prefer, whether the background should stay the same, and what clothing, colors, accessories, or pose details matter most. You can also include additional reference images when they help clarify hairstyles, facial features, or outfits.

Next, a human artist creates the illustration. Anime Cabinet offers 24 anime and cartoon styles, ranging from bold action-inspired looks to softer, storybook-inspired treatments. You might explore [Ghibli Style](/portraits/ghibli-style) for a warm, painterly mood, [Jujutsu Kaisen](/portraits/jujutsu-kaisen) for a sharper supernatural atmosphere, or [Demon Slayer](/portraits/demon-slayer) for expressive linework and dramatic color. These are fan-art inspired options: the artwork presents you as original characters rather than copying a specific copyrighted character.

A preview arrives within 72 hours under the standard process. Review it carefully and request changes to expressions, hair, colors, clothing, composition, or other details. Unlimited free revisions are included, so you can collaborate with the artist until the portrait feels right.

sections.heading: Choosing the best style for your couple portrait

blocks.text: There is no single best style for every couple. The right choice depends on the atmosphere you want. A soft, romantic treatment can suit an engagement photo or anniversary gift, while a high-energy action look may fit a couple who share an interest in shonen anime. Consider the emotion in the photograph first, then choose a visual language that strengthens it.

For a ninja-inspired concept, see the [Naruto portrait style](/portraits/naruto). If you prefer an adventurous crew or poster composition, explore [One Piece](/portraits/one-piece) or the [One Piece Wanted Poster](/portraits/one-piece-wanted-poster). [Dragon Ball Z](/portraits/dragon-ball-z) can bring an energetic, heroic feeling, while [Pokemon](/portraits/pokemon) offers a playful direction. Couples who want a darker mood may prefer [Attack on Titan](/portraits/attack-on-titan), [Bleach](/portraits/bleach), or [Death Note](/portraits/death-note).

You can also request a custom anime portrait without tying it to one named franchise. In that case, describe the mood, color palette, outfit, setting, and level of detail you want. The artist can use those instructions to create a distinctive interpretation of you both.

sections.heading: Can a wedding or engagement photo become anime art?

blocks.text: Yes. An artist can turn a wedding or engagement photo into a custom anime portrait from photo. These images often work especially well because they contain a clear story: a first look, a ceremony pose, a ring exchange, a dance, or a quiet moment together. You can preserve meaningful details such as a bouquet, veil, suit, jewelry, cultural clothing, venue, or sunset lighting.

For a wedding commission, identify the details that must remain accurate and the elements that can be stylized. If the original image includes several people, confirm whether you want only the couple featured or whether family members and guests should remain in the scene. The more specific your notes are, the easier it is for the artist to understand the importance of each detail.

sections.heading: How to order your custom couple anime portrait

blocks.text: Ordering is straightforward:

1. Choose the anime or cartoon direction that best matches your idea.
2. Upload a clear couple photo and any helpful reference images.
3. Add instructions about expressions, outfits, background, colors, pose, and important personal details.
4. Select the digital or physical product option that suits your intended use.
5. Review your preview within 72 hours and send any revision requests.
6. Approve the final artwork for delivery or printing.

You do not need to know art terminology. A simple note such as “keep the bouquet, soften the background, and make both expressions more joyful” gives the artist useful direction. If you are unsure which style fits your image, describe the mood and occasion in your order and ask for guidance.
